title: Nourishing Smoky Kenyan Hash
description: A hearty one-pot dish featuring smoky flavors, crispy edges, and a surprising pop from dried cranberries. Perfect for a vegan keto diet, this dish is ready in under an hour.
instructions: Heat coconut oil in a large cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat.
Add cumin seeds and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add chopped red onions and cook for 3-4 minutes, until softened.
Add diced sweet potatoes and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add chopped kale and cook for 2-3 minutes, until wilted.
Add sliced ginger and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add cauliflower florets and cook for 2-3 minutes, until slightly tender.
Add smoked paprika, black pepper, and dried cranberries. Stir to combine.
Transfer the skillet to the freezer and chill for 15 minutes to set the flavors.
Remove the skillet from the freezer and use a spatula to break up any large clumps.
Return the skillet to medium-high heat and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until crispy and golden brown.
Stir in lemon juice and cook for 1 minute, until heated through.
Serve hot, garnished with lemon wedges and chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Transfer the skillet to a wire rack to cool slightly before serving.
Adjust seasoning as needed with lemon juice, salt, or black pepper.
